name: Erdeniz Kurucan
bio: Erdeniz Kurucan is known for Veliaht (2025), Mutter: The Diary of a Mother (2026) and Ezel (2009).

credits.title: Mutter: The Diary of a Mother
credits.overview: On the fog-drenched Black Sea coast, a woman gives birth to a being that defies nature. As her body and mind begin to unravel, love becomes both her devotion and her disease.

credits.title: Miracle
credits.overview: After losing her home and all that she's known, a widowed Turkish woman finds herself in an unexpected love affair with a young Syrian refugee in Istanbul.
